support_story_1_headline: nung deng manufacturers sumulung la, ing komunidad sumulung ya.
support_story_1_lead: Protektahan ing kekang device kareng silent hardware traps ampo broken revisions.
support_story_1_body: Ing Innioasis regular yang mag roll out bayung firmwares para kareng players kalupa ning Y1 (targeting hidden board revisions kalupa ning 6.0, 7.0, ampo 8.0) na tahimik a magsira kareng lumang devices. Ing mas malala, ing karelang website alang babala ampo alang access kareng minunang firmwares para makabawi keng metung a bricked state. Ing Updater ampo ing Community Firmware project ila reng mag-archive kareng bage: i-archive mi la reng balang legacy stock ROM, automatic mi lang i-verify ing kekang hardware revision, ampo panatilyan mi lang ligtas a magdalagan deng kekang player.
support_story_1_item_1: Pamagligtas kareng mesira a maglarin: Deng safety checks makasiguradung deng bayung update e la kapilan man maka-brick kareng lumang hardware.
support_story_1_item_2: Archived Stock ROMs: Kumpletung koleksyon da reng orihinal a firmwares ning pabrika Innioasis mebura ya.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Ganap a flashing tools para keng macOS, Linux, ampo Windows parehu.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Automatic board detection para parati kang makakwa keng ustung package.
support_story_2_headline: Ala yang sirang Google Drives. alang hula-obra. Magobra yamu ing firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Matas a bilis, me-verify a imprastraktura ning komunidad a malyari mung asahan.
support_story_2_body: Ing pamag-track down kareng opisyal a Innioasis software keraklan mangabaldugan yang pamag-scour kareng forum para kareng expired a Google Drive links, mete nang Baidu cloud shares, ampo reng misteryosung zip files a alang flashing tools. Mekagawa kaming metung a mapanalig, independenting download network a maki verified SHA-256 integrity, update notifications, ampo step-by-step guided installs. Deng kekang donasyun direktang mag-ingat kareng downloads ampo hosting na gagawang posible ini 24 oras keng aldo, 365 aldo keng banua.
support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: Mabilis, direct a pamagdownload a alang limitasyun keng pamagdownload o dead links.
support_story_2_item_2: Update Notifications: Ma-alert ka potang mika bayung community release o fixes a mibaba.
support_story_2_item_3: Guided Step-by-Step Installs: Deng malino a visual prompts magdala la keka balang pindutan me ing button.
support_story_2_item_4: Multilingual Community: Ganap a localized keng English, Chinese, German, Spanish, French & Japanese.
support_story_3_headline: Ibuklat me ing ganap a potensyal ning kekang Innioasis player.
support_story_3_lead: Magdala yang Rockbox, custom lightweight operating systems, ampo audiophile freedom.
support_story_3_body: Ing stock factory software makagalus yamu keng babo na ning agyu nang gawan ning kekang Y1 o Y2 hardware. Ing kekaming komunidad dininan neng bie ing Rockbox, lightweight custom operating systems, audiophile codec playback, ampo custom themes. mamayad kaming physical hardware variations para subukan, i-reverse engineer, ampo i-verify ing balang install. Ing suporta keng Updater direktang magpondo kareng test units ampo magpabilis keng custom firmware development.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Audiophile playback ampo custom themes a maka-install kilub ning mapilan a sigundu.
support_story_3_item_2: Community Firmware: Battery enhancements, mas malinis a UI, ampo modernung suporta keng audio codec.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Testing mi la reng tune physical a devices bayu mi i-release ing nanu mang build.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% libre, privacy-first software a alang ads o tracking.
support_story_4_headline: Saupan mu kaming gawan ing e da gagawan ning Innioasis.
support_story_4_lead: Community-powered firmware preservation na mag-ingat kareng kekang devices keng landfill.
support_story_4_body: Potang ing metung a kumpanya ning hardware lumipat ya keng tutuking gadget, deng matwang modelu mipaburen la. Ing Innioasis ala yang suporta keng Linux, ala yang transparent a changelogs, ampo ala yang madaling paralan para mibawi nung mebigu ya ing pamag-install. Ing Updater atyu ya uling deng passionate a gagamit e la dapat magtapon keng perpektung masanting a music player. 100% ning ambag ning komunidad diretsu ya keng pamagbukas na niting kasangkapan para kareng sabla.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Proven recovery flows agyang e la bisang mag-boot deng devices.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux First-Class Support: Ganap a suportado ing MediaTek flashing kareng Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Detalyadung tala ning pamagluwal para abalu mu nung nanu ing pamagbayu.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Community Funded: Balang kape panatilyan neng makabuklat ing archive at alang bayad para kareng sabla.

err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Ing flashing tool pepakit na ing parehung linya keng milabas a {seconds} a sigundu at e ya mu rin patuloy ing pamanyulat keng firmware. Malyari yang mesira ing flash. nung ini ing tauli kareng adwang pamagpursigi keng balang paralan keng sistema na malyaring magbalik keng pilatan da, o nung ing MTKClient mu ing available keng makina ayni, i-restart me ing computer at subukan meng pasibayu.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: MTKClient mu ing magagamit para kening pamag-install. Malyari yang mesira ing flash. Paki-restart me ing computer at subukan meng pasibayu.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Malyari ya namang i-install ining computer gamit ing SP Flash Tool. nung malyari, lumipat ka keng SP Flash Tool at subukan meng pasibayu.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Malyari yang mesira ing flash. Pakibasa me ing mensahi king babo at i-restart me ing computer bayu me subukan pasibayu. nung i-click me ing OK, ing app tuknang ya para makapag-restart ka.

err_tool_unavailable_desc: Ing flashing tool o kailangang system drivers e la malyaring i-initialize. Paki-check la reng system permissions, driver setup, o i-reinstall me ing application.
err_driver_missing_desc: Malyari yang malyari ining error nung e ya maka-install ing MediaTek USB driver. Pindutan me ing Download Drivers para i-install me ing MediaTek USB driver, i-restart me ing kekang computer, at subukan meng pasibayu.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Atin yang cached a firmware file. Pilinan me ing Select Software para gawan meng pasibayu ing me-extract a files o i-download meng pasibayu ing firmware archive. Iti metung yang problema keng lokal a file, ali ya isyu keng USB connection.

2. Potang mag boot ya ing Rockbox, isaksak me ing USB cable keng kekang computer.
3. nung akit me keng player screen, kumpirman me ing USB Storage mode para ing device lumwal ya bilang drive.

1. Ilako me ing USB cable.
2. I-on me ing player at paburen meng mag-boot keng Rockbox.
3. Potang magdalagan ne ing Rockbox, ikonekta me ing USB cable, kaybat pindutan me ing Continue.

3. Ing app isamut no reng 360p themes ampo fonts, at i-overwrite la reng same-name files.
